title: Alcoa Corporation Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Alcoa Corporation (NYSE: AA; ASX: AAI) (Alcoa or the Company) today reported results for the second quarter 2026 that included record quarterly revenue, strong operational performance, and progress on multiple smelter capacity restarts, in addition to the announced acquisition of South32 Limiteds (South32) interests in its bauxite, alumina, and aluminum assets.
